import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert 'Dt_Customer' to datetime

# Calculate the age of the customers
current_year = pd.to_datetime('today').year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts',

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

)

scatter.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
scatter.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Education', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert 'Dt_Customer' to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], dayfirst=True)

# Calculate the age of the customers
current_year = pd.to_datetime('today').year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                           'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot of Age vs. Total Spending, colored by Education
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df, x='Age', y='Total_Spending', hue='Education', palette='deep', alpha=0.7
)

# Add labels and title
scatter.set_title('Customer Age vs. Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=16)
scatter.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
scatter.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)
